notes.title: 06-23 Dev Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hello hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Paolo here and I'd like to let you know what's next for Godslayer Arena. Before I get into that though, I just want to thank each and every one of you for supporting the game and for leaving so much valuable feedback. It really means a lot to me to see so many people playing through the game and I feel more motivated than ever to keep improving it. From the bottom of my heart thank you to everyone of you![/p][p][/p][p]This post will be a bit disorganized and I do not have any concrete dates for any of the changes I'm about to list, but I just want to keep you all in the loop for what I'm working on at the moment. Keep in mind that these are all subject to change, and if you all have any other suggestions please feel free to let me know! [/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]Immediate Attention[/b][/u][/h3][p]Many of you are expressing that the Huntress currently feels very underpowered when compared to the Bloodlord. I will be releasing a patch very soon to address her strength. This patch will focus mostly on number adjustments, and once time permits I will look into making more functional adjustments as necessary. [/p][p][/p][p]There is currently a game breaking bug where minions fail to despawn. This results in them attacking for the rest of the run and will eventually cause intense lag. Until I can get this figured out I recommend completely quitting out of the game and continuing your run from where you left off.[/p][p][/p][p]I am also currently working on performance improvements to the game.[/p][p][/p][p]The very first arena can feel impossible to pass without losing a life on the higher difficulties and will address this alongside the upcoming balance patch.[/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]Next Up[/b][/u][/h3][p]The current curse system is a poorly designed system that feels very frustrating and not fun at all. I will be scrapping the system entirely and replacing it with something completely new. While I can't say the specifics yet, This new system will have true bosses that are not just elites, and is focused more on empowering enemies rather than debuffing your build.[/p][p][/p][p]The mastery spell system will receive the following adjustments:[/p][list][*][p]Introduce a preferred mastery system that allows you to select 4 or more masteries before you start each run. One of your initially offered masteries will always be a preferred mastery.[/p][/*][*][p]Move the mastery selection to right after the first arena, and move the first gem selection to where the mastery selection currently is.[/p][/*][*][p]Use 2 fateweavers to reroll all 3 mastery options, compared to the current system that uses 1 fateweaver to reroll 1 option.[/p][/*][/list][p]
The non-arena combats will get some new mechanics to make them more in line with the strength of arena combats. The goal will be to make them more engaging and be a better test of your build strength before you enter the arena.[/p][p][/p][p][strike]Many people are leaving feedback that the run lengths are too long for their tastes, so the run lengths will be reduced 25 combats down to 20 combats. [/strike][/p][p][strike]I will also adjust the econ, exp, and all relevant shop values to make sure you still get to the same power level, just in a shorter amount of time.[/strike][/p][p]After receiving feedback on this I have decided to explore other options instead. Maybe only gate 0 will have 20 combats and gate 1 increases it to 25 to ensure new players aren't spending too long in their introductory run.[/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]After That[/b][/u][/h3][p]Once you all feel that the base game is in a good state, I'd love to try out some alternate game modes. I'm still in the process of designing what these new modes will look like, but if you have any ideas I'm all ears! [/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]Much Later[/b][/u][/h3][p]The third Godslayer will arrive after the base game's experience has been settled and after the new game modes are implemented.[/p][p][/p][p]New items and gems will also be added to the game! If you all feel that adding new items and gems dilutes the pool too much then I have no problem with adding a system to allow you to pick which gems and items can show up in your runs.[/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]As Time Permits[/b][/u][/h3][p]Sometime during Early Access I will be implementing a proper tutorial experience that slowly introduces the game's mechanics rather than the current system that shows a short text summary every few combats.[/p][p][/p][p]There will also be the usual balancing, bug fixing, and polish passes that you can expect throughout Early Access.[/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]Closing Out[/b][/u][/h3][p]That's it for this update. If you have a second to leave a review that would go a long way to help support the game. Thank you all again![/p][p][/p][p]-Paolo[/p]

notes.title: Huge Demo Update Coming Soon to Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Hello hello everyone!

Hope you all are doing well. I wanted to let you know that the demo for Godslayer Arena is getting a massive update for the Steam Next Fest on February 24th 10am PT.

Here are some of the most notable changes:

[list]
[*] A completely reworked spell pool for the Raging Bloodlord. This includes 50+ new and reworked spells that introduce completely new mechanics such as spell transformation, corpse consumption, minions, and special charges.
[*] ~8 new and reworked traits.
[*] 20+ new mastery spells
[*] A reworked mastery spell system that grants you a unique bonus if you chose a mastery spell of that trait. Mastery spells now only have one trait, and selecting a spell with that trait always activates the first breakpoint for that trait.
[*] 60+ new items
[*] 50+ new gems
[*] A new currency type that allows you to reroll the offered gems, items, zone modifiers, and mastery cards.
[*] New health system
[*] New codex/keyword system to make the game easier to learn.
[*] Updated visuals.
[/list]

Check out the trailer below. Hope you all have fun!

[previewyoutube=8J3hXUcswK8;full][/previewyoutube]

-Paolo

notes.title: v0.3.2.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Gem drag and drop now works properly.
[*]Fixed a bug where Chrono’s positional effects were reversed.
[*]General UI tweaks.
[*]Fixed a bug where some resonance rewards were granting wrong stats.
[*]Fixed a bug where some gem imbues would give you a different imbue than the one you selected.
[*]Fixed a bug where spells that get manablocked at the start of combat would still fill once.
[*]The demo panel at the end of a run can now be hidden.
[*]Fixed some typos and changed the wording of a few descriptions.
[*]The shadowborne minion’s HP bar now follows the minion correctly.
[*]Fixed a bug where Necroweave minions would not despawn.
[*]Fixed a bug where Oracle and Electros would trigger an additional time for each minion you had active.
[*]Fixed a bug where Infernum 6 gave the wrong values.
[/list]
